title: Sea Chronicles
description:
You're stranded on a sinking ship with a limited set of items. Combine them creatively to unlock new locations, uncover hidden secrets, and discover multiple endings—each choice brings a wild outcome!

Key Features: • Pop-Culture References: A world filled with quirky, nostalgic nods — mostly from SpongeBob — to keep you looking for easter eggs along the way.

• Bugs Collecting: Hunt down rare and ridiculous bugs scattered throughout the world. Some are dangerous. Some are just weird. All of them are worth finding.

• Death is Just Part of the Journey: Made the wrong move? Congrats, you found another ridiculous way to die.

• Absurd Humor and Puzzles: Enjoy bizarre challenges, unpredictable twists, and lmao moments as you make your way through the story.
description_short: Тонущий корабль. Очень много отсылок к SpongeBob. Недостаточно объяснений. Выбирись с корабля. Собирай жуков.
